title: 第017章 紫阳卫至杀气腾第018章 令牌惊退四方客
lines: 苏清雪的脸色，比宣纸还要苍白。她扶着冰凉的垂花门框，指尖因为用力而深深陷入木纹之中，娇躯微不可察地颤抖着。看着那个一步步走近的灰衣少年，看着他平静无波、却如同深渊般幽邃的眼睛，她仿佛置身于冰窖之中，从骨髓里渗出寒意。
前院的惨状，狼卫的尸体，赵刚的溃败，护卫的逃散……如同走马灯般在她眼前闪过。仅仅不到半个时辰，城主府经营多年、看似固若金汤的防御体系，就在这个少年面前，土崩瓦解，如同纸糊。
不，不是防御体系的问题。是眼前这个人，太过诡异，太过……可怕。
“带路。”秦夜的声音不大，却带着不容置疑的意味，将她从惊惧的泥潭中惊醒。
苏清雪深吸一口气，强迫自己挺直脊背，维持着最后一丝属于城主府大小姐的骄傲。她知道，此刻任何软弱和退缩，都只会让局面更加不堪。父亲昏迷，赵刚生死不知，她必须站出来。
“秦……秦公子，”苏清雪的声音带着一丝她自己都未察觉的沙哑和艰涩，“我父亲……方才急怒攻心，身体不适，正在后院休息。可否……容我先安排人照料赵统领，再……”
“不必。”秦夜打断她，目光扫了一眼远处被砸在影壁下、气息奄奄的赵刚，“他死不了。带我去见苏远山。现在。”
语气平淡，却透着一种不容置喙的冰冷。
苏清雪心脏猛地一缩。她知道，拖延和借口，在绝对的力量和意志面前，毫无意义。她咬了咬下唇，终于，缓缓松开门框，转过身，朝着内院深处走去，脚步有些虚浮。
秦夜跟在她身后一步之遥，步伐沉稳。目光看似随意地扫过内院的亭台楼阁，奇花异草，实则将周围的环境、可能的暗哨、以及苏清雪紧绷的背影，尽数纳入感知。
内院的护卫比前院更少，显然大部分力量都被抽调去守外门，或者已经在刚才的溃逃中不知所踪。仅存的几个仆役丫鬟，看到大小姐引着一个陌生的、衣衫染血的灰衣少年进来，皆是大惊失色，远远地躲开，不敢靠近。
穿过几道回廊，来到一处环境清幽、守卫相对森严的院落。这里是苏远山的寝殿所在。院门口站着四个面色惊惶、但还算忠心的护卫，看到苏清雪，又看到她身后跟着的秦夜，脸色骤变，下意识地握紧了兵器，挡在门口。
“大……大小姐……”一个护卫头目硬着头皮开口。
“让开。”苏清雪闭了闭眼，疲惫地挥手。
护卫们面面相觑，最终还是抵不过苏清雪的命令和秦夜那平静目光带来的无形压力，迟疑着让开了道路。
苏清雪推开寝殿的门，一股浓郁的药味混杂着血腥气扑面而来。殿内陈设华丽，此刻却一片狼藉，摔碎的瓷器和倾倒的家具显示出主人之前的暴怒。里间的床榻上，苏远山双目紧闭，脸色蜡黄，嘴角还残留着血渍，胸口缠着厚厚的绷带，一名老医师正在为他施针，旁边还站着两个神色惶急的幕僚。
看到苏清雪带着秦夜进来，那老医师和两个幕僚都是大惊失色，老医师手中的银针差点掉在地上。
“大……大小姐！此人……”一个幕僚指着秦夜，声音发抖。
“程老，父亲如何？”苏清雪没有理会幕僚，看向那老医师，正是被秦夜制住过的程济世。他显然已经被人救醒，匆匆赶来。
程济世看了一眼秦夜，眼中闪过一丝复杂难明的惊悸，低声道：“城主急怒攻心，气血逆冲，伤了心脉，老朽已施针稳住，但需静养，受不得任何刺激……”
“他静养不了了。”秦夜的声音，在安静的寝殿内响起，清晰得如同冰珠落玉盘。
所有人的目光，瞬间聚焦在他身上。
秦夜走到床榻前，目光平静地落在苏远山脸上。“苏城主，既然醒了，就别装了。我们谈谈。”
床榻上的苏远山，眼皮剧烈地颤动了几下，缓缓睁开。那是一双布满了血丝、充满了怨毒、恐惧、不甘和深深疲惫的眼睛。他死死盯着秦夜，胸口因为激动而微微起伏。
“你……你这个孽障……”苏远山声音嘶哑，如同破风箱，“你究竟……想怎么样？！”
“我想怎么样？”秦夜微微歪头，似乎觉得这个问题有些好笑，“苏城主，这个问题，应该我问你才对。是你女儿，设计陷害，欲置我于死地。是你，不分青红皂白，判我斩立决。是你们苏家，纵容手下，欺压良善，草菅人命。是你们，将我逼到绝路。”
他每说一句，苏远山的脸色就难看一分。苏清雪更是娇躯微颤，低垂着头，不敢看秦夜的眼睛。
“我所做的一切，不过是为了活下去，为了讨回一个公道。”秦夜缓缓道，“现在，我活着，站在了这里。那么，公道，也该讨了。”
“你……你要什么公道？”苏远山咬着牙，从齿缝里挤出字来，“钱？我给你！权？我也可以给你！只要你……”
“钱？权？”秦夜摇头，打断他，“苏城主，你以为所有人都和你一样，眼里只有这些东西吗？”
他顿了顿，目光转向苏清雪：“苏小姐，百花宴上，你自导自演那场戏，陷害于我，是为了退紫阳宗的婚，顺便踩着我这个‘废物’彰显你的冰清玉洁，我没说错吧？”
苏清雪猛地抬头，脸色瞬间惨白如纸，嘴唇哆嗦着，却无法反驳。这件事，竟被他查得如此清楚？！
“你父亲，为了讨好你，为了所谓的城主府威严，不问是非，就要我的命。”秦夜又看向苏远山，“秦家，为了撇清关系，讨好你，主动绑我送官，大义灭亲。”
“赵阔，赵刚，刀疤刘，还有你们城主府那些大大小小的蛀虫，欺男霸女，草菅人命，视百姓如草芥。”
秦夜的目光，缓缓扫过寝殿内的每一个人，最后，重新落回苏远山脸上，声音变得冰冷而肃杀：
“这些债，一笔一笔，该怎么算？”
寝殿内，落针可闻。只有苏远山粗重艰难的喘息声。
“你……你到底想怎样？”苏远山的声音带着一丝绝望的颤抖。他发现，眼前这个少年，根本不能用常理揣度，他不要钱，不要权，他要的，似乎是……彻底摧毁他们苏家赖以生存的一切！
“很简单。”秦夜竖起三根手指。
“第一，苏清雪，自毁容貌，去阿萝爹娘坟前，磕头谢罪，守墓三年。三年内，若阿萝不原谅，你便一直守下去。若阿萝原谅，你可活。”
“第二，苏远山，自废修为，辞去城主之位，将城主府历年贪墨、盘剥所得，尽数散于城内贫苦百姓，并向全城公告，陈述你父女及城主府历年罪状。”
content_en:
Su Qingxue's face was paler than rice paper. She held onto the cold hanging flower door frame, her fingertips sinking deeply into the wood grain due to the force, and her delicate body trembled imperceptibly. Looking at the young man in gray who was approaching step by step, looking at his calm eyes that were as deep as the abyss, she felt as if she was in an ice cellar, with chills oozing from her bones.
The tragic scene in the front yard, the corpse of the wolf guard, Zhao Gang's defeat, the escape of the guards... flashed before her eyes like a revolving lantern. In less than half an hour, the seemingly impregnable defense system of the City Lord's Mansion, which had been in operation for many years, collapsed in front of this young man, like paper.
No, it's not about the defense system. The person in front of him was too weird, too... scary.
"Lead the way." Qin Ye's voice was not loud, but it carried an unmistakable meaning, waking her up from the quagmire of fear.
Su Qingxue took a deep breath and forced herself to straighten her back, maintaining the last trace of pride belonging to the eldest lady of the City Lord's Mansion. She knew that any weakness and retreat at this moment would only make the situation worse. Her father is in a coma, and she doesn't know whether Zhao Gang is alive or dead. She must stand up.
"Qin... Young Master Qin," Su Qingxue's voice contained a hint of hoarseness and harshness that she had not even noticed, "My father... has just been furious and unwell, and is resting in the backyard. Can you... allow me to arrange for someone to take care of Commander Zhao first, and then..."
"No need." Qin Ye interrupted her and glanced at the dying Zhao Gang who was smashed under the screen wall in the distance. "He can't die. Take me to see Su Yuanshan. Now."
The tone was calm, but there was an undeniable coldness to it.
Su Qingxue's heart suddenly shrank. She knew that delays and excuses were meaningless in the face of absolute power and will. She bit her lower lip, and finally, she slowly let go of the door frame, turned around, and walked toward the depths of the inner courtyard, her steps a little shaky.
Qin Ye followed her one step behind, his steps steady. His eyes seemed to casually scan the pavilions and pavilions in the inner courtyard, as well as the exotic flowers and plants, but in fact, he took in all the surrounding environment, possible secret whistles, and Su Qingxue's tense back into his perception.
There were fewer guards in the inner courtyard than in the front courtyard. It was obvious that most of the force had been deployed to guard the outer gate, or had disappeared in the rout just now. The few remaining servants and maids were frightened when they saw the eldest lady leading a strange young man in gray clothes with blood-stained clothes. They stayed away and did not dare to approach.
After passing through several corridors, we came to a courtyard with a quiet environment and relatively tight guards. This is where Su Yuanshan's dormitory is. There were four frightened but loyal guards standing at the entrance of the courtyard. When they saw Su Qingxue and Qin Ye following her, their expressions suddenly changed and they subconsciously clenched their weapons to block the door.
"Eldest... eldest lady..." a guard leader said bravely.
"Get out of the way." Su Qingxue closed her eyes and waved her hand tiredly.
The guards looked at each other, but in the end they couldn't resist the invisible pressure brought by Su Qingxue's order and Qin Ye's calm gaze, and hesitantly moved out of the way.
Su Qingxue pushed open the door of the dormitory, and a strong smell of medicine mixed with the smell of blood hit her face. The palace was gorgeously furnished, but it was now in a mess. The broken porcelain and overturned furniture showed the owner's previous rage. On the bed in the back room, Su Yuanshan's eyes were closed, his face was sallow, there were still blood stains on the corners of his mouth, and his chest was wrapped with a thick bandage. An old doctor was giving him acupuncture, and two anxious-looking staff members stood beside him.
Seeing Su Qingxue bringing Qin Ye in, the old doctor and the two staff were shocked. The silver needle in the old doctor's hand almost dropped to the ground.
"Miss... Miss! This person..." A staff member pointed at Qin Ye, his voice trembling.
"Mr. Cheng, how is your father?" Su Qingxue ignored the staff and looked at the old doctor, who was none other than Cheng Jishi who had been restrained by Qin Ye. He had obviously been rescued and rushed over.
Cheng Jishi glanced at Qin Ye, with a trace of complicated and unexplainable panic flashing in his eyes, and whispered: "The city lord is furious, his energy and blood are rushing back, and his heart is hurt. The old man has stabilized it with acupuncture, but he needs to rest and cannot bear any stimulation..."
"He can't rest anymore." Qin Ye's voice sounded in the quiet dormitory, as clear as ice beads falling on a jade plate.
Everyone's eyes were instantly focused on him.
Qin Ye walked to the bed and looked calmly at Su Yuanshan's face. "City Lord Su, now that you're awake, stop pretending. Let's talk."
Su Yuanshan's eyelids trembled violently a few times on the bed, then he slowly opened them. It was a pair of eyes covered with bloodshot eyes, full of resentment, fear, unwillingness and deep exhaustion. He stared at Qin Ye, his chest rising and falling slightly with excitement.
"You... you evildoer..." Su Yuanshan's voice was hoarse, like a broken bellows, "What on earth... do you want?!"
"What do I want?" Qin Ye tilted his head slightly, seeming to find this question a bit funny, "City Lord Su, I should ask you this question. It was your daughter who framed me and wanted to kill me. It was you who sentenced me to death indiscriminately. It was your Su family who indulged his subordinates, oppressed good people, and took human lives lightly. It was you who pushed me to the edge."
Every time he said something, Su Yuanshan's face became uglier. Su Qingxue's delicate body trembled slightly, her head lowered, not daring to look into Qin Ye's eyes.
"Everything I did was just to survive and to seek justice." Qin Ye said slowly, "Now, I am alive and standing here. Then, it is time to seek justice."
"You...what justice do you want?" Su Yuanshan gritted his teeth and squeezed out the words, "Money? I'll give it to you! Rights? I can give it to you too! As long as you..."
"Money? Power?" Qin Ye shook his head and interrupted, "City Lord Su, do you think everyone is the same as you and only sees these things?"
He paused and turned to Su Qingxue: "Miss Su, you directed and acted in that scene at the Hundred Flowers Banquet. You framed me in order to withdraw from the Ziyang Sect's marriage, and by the way, you stepped on me, a 'trash', to show off your innocence. Am I right?"
Su Qingxue suddenly raised her head, her face turned as pale as a sheet of paper, her lips were trembling, but she could not refute. How could he find out this matter so clearly? !
"Your father, in order to please you and for the so-called majesty of the City Lord's Mansion, took my life regardless of right or wrong." Qin Ye looked at Su Yuanshan again, "The Qin family, in order to estrange the relationship and please you, took the initiative to kidnap me and send me to an official position, and to destroy the family members for justice."
"Zhao Kuo, Zhao Gang, Scar Liu, and those big and small bugs in your city lord's palace bully men and women, take human life lightly, and treat the common people like nothing."
Qin Ye's eyes slowly swept across everyone in the dormitory, and finally fell back on Su Yuanshan's face, and his voice became cold and solemn:
"How should we calculate these debts one by one?"
In the sleeping hall, you can hear a needle drop. There was only the sound of Su Yuanshan's heavy and labored breathing.
"You...what do you want?" Su Yuanshan's voice trembled with a hint of despair. He found that the young man in front of him couldn't be judged by common sense at all. He didn't want money or power. What he wanted seemed to be...to completely destroy everything that the Su family relied on for survival!
"It's very simple." Qin Ye raised three fingers.
"First, Su Qingxue disfigured herself, went to the grave of A Luo's father and mother, kowtowed to apologize, and guarded the tomb for three years. If A Luo does not forgive within three years, you will continue to guard it. If A Luo forgives, you can live."
"Second, Su Yuanshan abandoned his cultivation and resigned as the city lord. He distributed all the gains from corruption and exploitation in the city lord's palace to the poor people in the city, and announced to the whole city, stating the crimes of your father, daughter and the city lord's palace over the years."
title_en: Chapter 017: Ziyang Guard becomes murderous Chapter 018: The token scares away the guests from all directions
